PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 19, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  COMMISSION@LBUTILITIES.ORG

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  26-54346  Recommendation to approve February 5, 2026 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54347  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to amend Agreement UT-3900 with Anser Advisory Management LLC, for
  the S-8 Sewer Lift Station Rehabilitation Project (SC-0359), to increase the contract
  amount by $300,000, for a revised total contract amount not to exceed $1,223,153,
  and to extend the contract term through September 30, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

REGULAR AGENDA

3.  26-54348  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal UD-26-302 for Emergency
  Planning Consulting Services, and award a contract to Navigating Preparedness
  Associates LLC, in a total amount not to exceed $187,500 for a one-year period,
  and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter
  into the contract, including any necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54349  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute a contract and all
  documents necessary, including any necessary subsequent amendments, with
  Western Audio Visual (A/V), for as-needed audio visual design, integration, and
  support services, in an annual amount not to exceed $250,000, for an initial one-

  year term, with the option to renew for two additional one-year periods, at the
  discretion of the General Manager.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54350  Recommendation to receive and file Water Resources Plan Supply and Demand
  Forecast.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-54351  Recommendation to receive and file February 5, 2026 Planning Committee Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-54352  Recommendation to receive and file the General Manager’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Assistant to the Board, certify that the agenda was posted not less than
72 hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online
at https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call
the Board of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570-
6626 (telecommunications for the deaf) by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.
